name: doctidex-git
description: Create, navigate, mount, maintain, validate, and review doctidex directory trees in Git repositories.

interface.shortDescription: Work with doctidex directory trees in Git.
interface.longDescription: A general doctidex Git workflow with Codex discovery metadata and prompts. Files remain available to native agent tools.
defaultPrompt: Set up doctidex in this Git working tree.
Navigate this doctidex tree and restore only required mounts.
Review doctidex-aware Git changes before handoff.
